map.输入质量、弹簧刚度、激励频率，计算系统固有频率、频率比、传递率与隔振效率: Enter mass, spring stiffness and excitation frequency to compute the system natural frequency, frequency ratio, transmissibility and isolation efficiency
map.单自由度 fn=(1/2π)√(k/m) 估算振动固有频率。: Single degree of freedom: fn = (1/2π)√(k/m) estimates the natural frequency of vibration.
map.由静变形 δ 反推 fn（δ=m·g/k）。: Back-calculate fn from static deflection δ (δ = m·g/k).
map.：若激振 30 Hz，fn≈15.9 Hz，频率比 r=30/15.9≈1.89: : With excitation at 30 Hz and fn about 15.9 Hz, the frequency ratio r = 30/15.9, about 1.89, greater than √2, so the system is in the isolation region with transmissibility below 1 and effective vibration reduction.
map.静变形和频率关系？: Relationship between static deflection and frequency?
map.δ=m·g/k，代入得 fn=(1/2π)√(g/δ)，只用测得的静挠度即可估固: δ = m·g/k, and substituting gives fn = (1/2π)√(g/δ), so the natural frequency can be estimated from the measured static deflection alone.
map.频率比为何要 >√2？: Why must the frequency ratio be greater than √2?
map.当激振频率/固有频率 >√2 时传递率<1，系统起隔振作用；<√2 反而放大振动: When the excitation frequency / natural frequency ratio is greater than √2, transmissibility is below 1 and the system isolates vibration; below √2 it amplifies vibration instead.
